admin-reading-card: Lore glossary terms that auto-link in articles and books, and news story timelines.
admin-reading-lede: Manage the lore glossary and group related news articles into stories.
challenge-bad-target: Enter a goal of at least 1.
challenge-how: Books count when you finish them in the reader or move them to your Read shelf.
challenge-signed-out: Sign in to set a reading goal
editor-description: Notes are private unless you make them public.
finished-book: Finished “{{title}}”. Added to your Read shelf.
glossary-empty-hint: Add a term and its first mention in any news, blog or library text will link to it.
glossary-link-label: Link (optional, https:// or a site path)
grade-hidden: The grade level is only calculated for English, so it is hidden rather than shown wrong.
highlight-failed: Could not save that. Try again.
highlights-empty: Select any passage to highlight it or attach a note. Only you see them unless you make a note public.
highlights-signed-out: Sign in to highlight passages and keep notes.
highlights-signed-out-title: Sign in to see your highlights
make-public-hint: Others can read your note, and your highlight counts toward “N readers highlighted this”.
my-reading-lede: Your highlights and notes, your shelves, and your reading challenge.
no-highlights-hint: Select text in a blog post, news article or library book to highlight it or add a note.
no-long-sentences: No sentences of {{n}} or more words.
no-paint: This browser cannot draw highlights on the page, so they are listed here instead.
no-text-layer-hint: This page is a scanned image with no text layer, so it cannot be highlighted or annotated. Pages that do have text can be.
only-you: Only you can see this shelf
orphans-heading_one: {{count}} highlight no longer matches the text
orphans-heading_other: {{count}} highlights no longer match the text
orphans-hint: The passage was edited or removed. We list these rather than guess where they belong.
popular-legend: Dotted underlines mark passages at least {{n}} readers highlighted.
ruler-hint: Dims everything except a line of text. Move it with the up and down arrow keys.
selection-too-long: That selection is too long to highlight. Select a shorter passage.
shelf-public-toggle: Show the {{shelf}} shelf on your profile
shelves-empty-hint: Open a book in the library and use its Shelf menu to add it here.
sign-in-to-highlight: Sign in to save highlights and notes.
stories-empty-hint: Create one, then link the related news articles to it.
story-delete-desc: “{{title}}” and its timeline page will be removed. The articles stay.
story-empty: No published articles in this story yet
story-suggest-needs-article: Link at least one article first; suggestions are based on its tags.
text-failed: Could not read the text of this part of the book.
